frequency_question: How often does the Department of Education move to fully revoke the recognition of an established accrediting agency?
membership_rule: Includes final agency actions to terminate recognition of an accrediting agency recognized under the Higher Education Act; excludes voluntary withdrawals or minor sanctions.
provenance_note: claims 60 cases from only 3 named (20.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: Identified 3 major revocations of established agencies since the 1992 HEA amendments.
known_gaps: Minor sanctions or probationary periods that did not result in total revocation are excluded.
skeleton: Total recognized accrediting agencies (~60) multiplied by the rarity of revocation events per cycle.
multiplier: 3 revocations / 60 agencies / 34 years = ~0.0014 annual probability per agency
validity_reason: The regulatory framework for accrediting agencies remains stable under current HEA provisions.
